hero.title: Moments That
hero.subtitle: From industry expos to team milestones — a visual journey through the events, achievements, and people that make Invendis.

items.title: Connected Britain 2026
items.description: Invendis attended the recent Connected Britain Event 2026 from 9–10th September 2026 and was honoured to showcase Intel based Edge Compute devices and explain about the product portfolio.

items.title: Intel ISB Connect 2026
items.description: Showcase of the latest Intel Edge Devices at the Taj Hotel, Bengaluru, on 13th August 2026.

items.title: Automation Expo 2026
items.description: Invendis participated in the Industrial Automation Expo 2026, one of India's largest events for automation related technology from 22nd–25th July 2026.

items.title: ElAsia 2026
items.description: Invendis participated in ElAsia from May 14–17, 2026.

items.title: Embedded World Germany 2026
items.description: Took part in Embedded World Germany, the only trade show dedicated to the latest embedded technology, from 10–12 March 2026.

items.title: Intel Alderlake Award
items.description: Invendis received an award for designing the Alderlake Power-On Board in a record 3 days under the Make in India initiative, in March 2026.

items.title: Coins Partner Awards 2025
items.description: Invendis received the business excellence award at the Coins IT Partner Summit 5.0, held from 15–17 December 2025 in Goa.
